items.title: Sky Monster: Skeleton Soldier
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: In the ancient times, a giant skeleton soldier created its own kingdom in the middle of deep forest floating islands, explore all its secrets and discover the secret entrances!

items.title: The Lost World
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Explore a long forgotten civilization with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Archaeologists have long spoken in hushed tones of a civilization many believe to be myth. Few have journeyed deep enough in the great expanses of the world in search of it, but you are no ordinary explorer. Can you discover all its splendors?

items.title: Mutated Spooks
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: These scary monsters are perfect for terrifying your friends! From a creepy spider to a frightening skeleton, these creatures will surely be the talk of your Halloween party!

items.title: Fruits Secret Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: A watermelon is the entrance to an amazing and delicious hidden base where you can find all types of delicious fruits!

items.title: Kawaii Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
This package is perfect for you if you love to look super cute and trendy! 

- 12 different skins
- perfect for roleplay
- have fun

items.title: Super Cool Teens
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Do you want to look super cool? Then get these skins now! You'll be the coolest teen around!

- 12 themed skins.
- 2 free skins!
- By rvan

items.title: Purple!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Is purple your favorite color? Then this is the skin pack for you! Put on a stylish purple outfit, and show it off to all of your friends.

+ 12 teen skins
+ Unique outfit designs

items.title: Diamond Underground Base
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
One of the most expensive underground bases, stocked with plenty of diamonds!

+ Includes chests packed with diamonds.
+ Rooms include a crop farm, mob room and storage room.

items.title: The 80s
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Check out this most excellent skin pack that's sure to make you look stellar! Inspired by the 80's, you'll look totally righteous in these skins!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Trendy Zombies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Be cute while showing off your undead self! Green skin is in this season and zombies can be cute too!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Halloween Couple
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
During the creepiest times of the year, you do not want to be lonely. Dress up with your friend and wear the same costume!

+ 16 Matching skins!
+ Free skins: Clown Darliene & Clown Nate
+ Couple, spooky & fashionable!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: SkyBlock 100 Days
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Play classic Skyblock and take on the 100 Days challenge! Explore various islands, find hidden treasures and defeat the ender dragon and survive for 100 days!

Includes:

- Hidden treasure
- Floating islands
- Skyblock island
- Multiplayer and single player
- And much more!

By KA Studios

items.title: Office Fashion
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Dress to impress your colleagues during your workdays. Get into business with your friends!

+ 10 formal skins!
+ Free skin: Elise
+ Fashion, work & impress!

By CubeCraft

items.title: Tools Expansion
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
See which crafting recipe you need, collect the required items and craft new tools in this tools expansion! All tools have unique abilities which give you a new survival experience! Shoot with the laser, pull blocks through the sky towards you with the magnet and collect spawn eggs!

+Craftable!
+Tools have unique abilities!
+Super pickaxe, chainsaw, laser, magnet and etc.

items.title: Cartoon Monsters
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Suit up in your new epic cartoon monster skin and show everyone how cute or how horrifying you can be in these skins! Which creature will you choose?

- 11 monster skins!
- Created by Hourglass members!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Halloween Masks
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Dress up at the Halloween party and delight everyone with amazing scary costumes!

+ 12 scary skins
+ 2 free skins

items.title: Mutant Monsters
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
The spell mutated you to a Halloween monster. Don't be scared to mutate yourself!

+ 12 HD mutant skins!
+ Free skin: Cosmic Werewolf
+ Great for seasonal roleplay!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You like Lucky Blocks? You enjoy playing Skyblock? This map combines both!
Start with nothing, explore the different islands and test your luck. Will you be able to defeat the Ender Dragon?

+300 different outcomes
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Lucky Blocks Survival
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
In this little desert village, the luck is on your side! Destroy the Lucky Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Music Maker Halloweenier
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Turn your blocks into music with all new spooky songs and instruments! You can mix songs using different sounds at the push of a button in a gigantic concert hall. 

+ Add lyrics and fireworks to play in time with your song
+ New giant, playable guitar
+ 3 demo songs
+ 7 instruments
+ 4 skins
+ Save and load your creations

items.title: Halloween Horrors
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Give you friends a good ol’ scare with these spooky and gruesome Halloween costumes. Nothing says Halloween quite like an unsightly monster to leave your friends trembling.

items.title: NEON DRIP
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
When the world gets dark, the neon drip will shine! These fierce neon monsters are equipped and ready for anything in their way. Are you prepared for battle?

+ Includes many iconic skins

items.title: Yacht
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome to Yacht, the only floating survival base! Trade with villagers, farm mobs, store loot in the storage, and swim in the hot tub or coral reef. Customize the yacht just the way you like or go exploring the map. Where will you navigate captain? The yacht includes 21 survival farms and a 3D model helicopter you can fly with. Start your ship adventure!

- By Honeyfrost

items.title: Woodland Cabin
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Tired of all these city mansions and all this noise?
Rest in this beloved mansion, lost in the woodlands.
